blind.description: A stylized cartoon apple tree consisting of a short, thick brown trunk with flared roots, multiple chunky branches, puffy green foliage clumps, and bright red apples distributed across the foliage. The geometry is solid, smooth, and continuous with hand-painted stylized textures. It stands directly on its root base flat on the ground with no auxiliary pedestal or base slab.
blind.from_above: An irregular rounded cluster of green foliage blobs studded with shiny red apples, casting a shadow downward/leftward.
blind.height_vs_figure: Slightly taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 6 to 6.5 ft tall) and about as wide as the figure is tall (around 5 to 6 ft across).
